title: 20 years ago, Dawn Robinson paid $40,000 for 2.4 acres in New Jersey; Middle Township is now trying to take the land for just $7,000 more
summary_full: A woman from South Jersey has taken a stand against the government's plan to acquire her land, which is intended for a new housing development in Middle Township. She asserts that the seizure does not serve public interest. Ongoing legal proceedings and negotiations haven't resolved the matter, underscoring the potential consequences of eminent domain on marginalized communities.
